@Lenthan_Q @CryptoBudFox @AmonMetalHead @richburroughs @mozilla @dogecoin @BitPay Do you? You understand Bitcoin's energy use doesn't scale linearly right? 

And where did I say x100? All I said was that it would start to eat up underperforming hedges like gold and US treasury bonds.

@Lenthan_Q @CryptoBudFox @AmonMetalHead @richburroughs @mozilla @dogecoin @BitPay I absolutely think it can continue. Treasury bonds pay 1.5%. Inflation even at the lowball CPI is around 6%. Anybody leaving money in treasury bonds is real terms losing money. 

I think we will see capital flow from such traditional but underperforming hedges into Bitcoin.

@Lenthan_Q @CryptoBudFox @AmonMetalHead @richburroughs @mozilla @dogecoin @BitPay I don't think you need to believe it will go to the moon or that you need to mortgage your house and go all in but I do believe Bitcoin is the most asymetrical bet we are ever likely to see in our lifetime and so getting off zero and self-custodying is just common sense.
